item.title: Show HN: News Aggregator for Science and Technology
item.summary: I built Paper Run because i've always wanted a simple page where i can see the latest science and tech news from reputable sources. I built it with Laravel and Vue 3 if anyone is curious. Any Feedback is appreciated. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49251142 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
